Question 18
?

Find matrices P and D such that PDP−1=E, where D is a diagonal matrix and E=[79−6−8].

a
D=[1002] and P=[3−121]
b
D=[−1002] and P=[3−1−11]
c
E is not diagonalizable
d
D=[100−1] and P=[1−1−21]
e
D=[100−2] and P=[3−1−21]
